Hi,

Thank you for reporting the issue with invoice posting in SAP. Please check the full error message and note the message number (for example F5 201 'posting period not open'). Then verify that the posting date is in an open period; if the period is closed, you may change the posting date to the current period if allowed by your finance policy. Also, check that the vendor and cost centre are not blocked. After these checks, please retry the posting once. Avoid retrying repeatedly to prevent duplicate documents.

If the posting still fails, please escalate to ERP Finance Support with the error message number, especially since this affects month-end closing.

Best regards,
IT Service Desk

Hi, to resolve the issue with your emails stuck in the Outbox and not receiving new ones, please follow these steps:

1. Check the status bar in Outlook. If it shows 'Working Offline', go to Send/Receive and select 'Work Offline' to switch it off.
2. Close Outlook completely and then start it again.
3. Try opening Outlook on the web at outlook.office.com. If email works there, the problem is with the desktop app.
4. If the problem persists, repair your Outlook profile by going to Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles > Repair.
5. Clear the Outbox by moving stuck messages with large attachments to Drafts and resend them without the attachment.

If Outlook on the web also fails or if several users are affected, please let us know so we can escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support. Let me know if you need further assistance!

Hi, thanks for reporting the VPN slowness in the evenings. To help improve your VPN performance, please try the following steps:

1. Test your home internet connection without the VPN, for example by running a speed test. If it seems slow, please restart your home router.
2. Use a wired connection if possible, or move closer to your Wi-Fi router to improve signal strength.
3. Disconnect and reconnect the VPN, making sure to choose the nearest gateway.
4. Update your VPN client from the Company Portal to ensure you have the latest version.
5. Close any large uploads or streaming activities while connected to the VPN, as these can affect performance.

If the VPN connection drops more than three times an hour while your home connection is good, please let us know so we can escalate to Network & Remote Access for further investigation. Hope this helps!

1. Test your home internet connection without the VPN, for example by running a speed test. If it seems slow, please restart your home router.

3. Disconnect and reconnect the VPN, making sure to choose the nearest gateway.
4. Update your VPN client from the Company Portal to ensure you have the latest version.
5. Close any large uploads or streaming activities while connected to the VPN, as these can affect performance.

Hi, to resolve the issue with emails stuck in your Outbox and not receiving new ones, please follow these steps:

1. Check the status bar in Outlook. If it shows 'Working Offline', go to Send/Receive and select 'Work Offline' to switch it off.

Hi, to resolve the issue with emails stuck in your Outbox and not receiving new ones, please follow these steps:

1. Check the status bar in Outlook. If it shows 'Working Offline', go to Send/Receive and select 'Work Offline' to switch it off.
2. Close Outlook completely and then start it again.
3. Open Outlook on the web at outlook.office.com. If your email works there, the problem is with the desktop app.
4. If the problem persists, repair your Outlook profile by going to Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles > Repair.
5. Clear the Outbox by moving stuck messages with large attachments to Drafts and resend them without the attachment.

If Outlook on the web also fails or if multiple users are affected, please let us know so we can escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support.

Hi, to resolve the issue with emails stuck in your Outbox and not receiving new ones, please follow these steps:

1. Check the status bar in Outlook. If it shows 'Working Offline', go to Send/Receive and select 'Work Offline' to switch it off.
2. Close Outlook completely and then start it again.
3. Try opening Outlook on the web at outlook.office.com. If your email works there, the problem is with the desktop app.
4. If the problem persists, repair your Outlook profile by going to Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles > Repair.
5. Also, clear the Outbox by moving stuck messages with large attachments to Drafts and resend them without the attachment.

If Outlook on the web also fails or multiple users are affected, please let us know so we can escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support.

Hi, to resolve the issue with emails stuck in your Outbox and not receiving new ones, please follow these steps:

1. Check the status bar in Outlook. If it shows 'Working Offline', go to Send/Receive and select 'Work Offline' to switch it off.
2. Close Outlook completely and then start it again.
3. Open Outlook on the web at outlook.office.com. If your email works there, the problem is with the desktop app.
4. If the problem persists, repair your Outlook profile by going to Control Panel > Mail > Show Profiles > Repair.
5. Clear the Outbox by moving stuck messages with large attachments to Drafts and resend them without the attachment.

If Outlook on the web also fails or if several users are affected, please let us know so we can escalate the issue to Messaging & Collaboration Support.

Hi! To resolve the issue with emails stuck in your Outbox and not receiving new ones, please follow these steps:

5. Also, clear the Outbox by moving stuck messages with large attachments to Drafts and resend them without the attachment.
